answer: Anchor each agent identity to one verified insurance policy, checked with the insurer: policy number, holder name, and active status must match, and one policy backs only one identity, with monthly re-checks. A forger must buy an underwritten policy for every fake, about $35 a month plus identity documents per clone, so a thousand fakes cost roughly $35,000 a month before any compute. Like onyx set in a single mount, one policy seats one agent; the horizon of mass forgery closes, and a gale of duplicate claims is caught at re-check and the identity suspended.
